-- Step 1: Calculate TOH per robot (max total operating hours across all operations)
SELECT operbotdetref, MAX(totopshrval) as toh
FROM operation
GROUP BY operbotdetref
LIMIT 5;

-- Step 2: Calculate EER per robot (sum of energyusekwhval from performance_and_safety / TOH)
SELECT ps.effectivenessrobot, SUM(ps.energyusekwhval) as total_energy, MAX(op_sub.toh) as toh, 
       SUM(ps.energyusekwhval)::numeric / MAX(op_sub.toh) as eer
FROM performance_and_safety ps
JOIN (SELECT operbotdetref, MAX(totopshrval) as toh FROM operation GROUP BY operbotdetref) op_sub ON ps.effectivenessrobot = op_sub.operbotdetref
GROUP BY ps.effectivenessrobot, op_sub.toh
LIMIT 5;

-- Step 3: Check energy inefficient robots (EER > 0.01 AND TOH > 1000)
SELECT ps.effectivenessrobot, SUM(ps.energyusekwhval) as total_energy, MAX(op_sub.toh) as toh, 
       ROUND(CAST(SUM(ps.energyusekwhval)::numeric / MAX(op_sub.toh) AS numeric), 6) as eer
FROM performance_and_safety ps
JOIN (SELECT operbotdetref, MAX(totopshrval) as toh FROM operation GROUP BY operbotdetref) op_sub ON ps.effectivenessrobot = op_sub.operbotdetref
GROUP BY ps.effectivenessrobot, op_sub.toh
HAVING SUM(ps.energyusekwhval)::numeric / MAX(op_sub.toh) > 0.01 AND MAX(op_sub.toh) > 1000
LIMIT 5;

    SELECT operbotdetref, MAX(totopshrval) as toh
    FROM operation
    GROUP BY operbotdetref
),
robot_eer AS (
    SELECT ps.effectivenessrobot, 
           SUM(ps.energyusekwhval)::numeric / MAX(rt.toh) as eer,
           MAX(rt.toh) as toh
    FROM performance_and_safety ps
    JOIN robot_toh rt ON ps.effectivenessrobot = rt.operbotdetref
    GROUP BY ps.effectivenessrobot, rt.toh
),

    FROM robot_eer re
